scope: Pinned Qwen3.8-27B-GPTQ-G128, eager batch-1 FP8 E4M3 KV, 1600-token attention pages, identical teacher-forced tokens; full-vocabulary logits after P=128 smoke or P=4096 prefill and selected decode forwards
accuracy_objective: At every selected checkpoint, move at most 2% of probability mass (TV), retain at least 9 of the reference top 10 tokens, and retain the reference top 1 unless its own logit margin is at most 0.1. KL(Python || C++) is an additional tail-sensitive bound. Nonfinite logits fail before metrics are computed.
baseline_before_candidate_tuning: 2026-09-27 periodic, German/English technical text, and C++ code P4096/D1024, plus periodic P4096/D2048; max observed TV 0.018243928763799596 and KL(Python || C++) 0.0011231690940174915, min top-10 overlap 9, all top-1 exact
policy: Freeze before P3/P4 tuning. Do not relax in response to a faster candidate; investigate or reject a failing candidate. A near-tie top-1 change still must pass TV, KL, and top-10 overlap. Layer/conv-state gates remain a separate P2 task.
